profile.address: 6872, Watson Court, Vint Hill Farms, Fauquier County, Virginia, 20187
profile.reading:
OVH US East Vint Hill is one of two data centers that marked OVHcloud's entry into the United States, located on Watson Court within the Vint Hill Farms area of Fauquier County, Virginia, roughly 40 miles southwest of Washington, DC. OVHcloud is a French cloud and hosting company, one of the largest in Europe, that generally builds and operates its own data centers and designs much of its own server hardware rather than leasing capacity as a colocation tenant. This site opened in 2018 alongside a sister facility in Hillsboro, Oregon, giving OVHcloud parallel East Coast and West Coast anchors in the American market, and the company publicly marked both sites' fifth anniversary in 2023.

The Vint Hill area itself has a long institutional history as a government communications and training site before its later redevelopment into a mixed use business and technology park, which today hosts data centers, light industrial tenants and office users drawn by existing power infrastructure and a location outside the densest and most competitive parts of the Northern Virginia data center market in Loudoun County. That context helps explain why a European cloud provider would choose Fauquier County over the more crowded Ashburn corridor for a facility built to serve its own network rather than to attract third party colocation tenants.

OVHcloud has described the technology inside this facility, as with its other data centers, as built around a proprietary water cooling system that the company says helps deliver some of the lowest power usage effectiveness ratings in the industry, along with a vertically integrated approach to designing, building and eventually recycling its own servers across multiple operational lifecycles. Beyond those general statements, OVHcloud has not published a power capacity figure, square footage, or formal certifications specific to this Vint Hill building, and no such figures are estimated here. Given OVHcloud's ownership and operating model, this site most likely supports the company's own public cloud, private cloud and dedicated server products for customers across the Americas rather than a single outside anchor tenant, though OVHcloud does not publish a per site tenant list. No county permit or zoning record specific to this address has been reviewed for this entry.

reading.body:
OVH US East Vint Hill opened in 2018 as one of two facilities marking OVHcloud's entry into the United States market, built to serve the company's own cloud and dedicated server products across the Americas rather than to attract third-party colocation tenants. The facility sits in Fauquier County, Virginia, roughly 40 miles southwest of Washington, DC, in a technology park area with existing power infrastructure but outside the densely packed Ashburn corridor of Loudoun County. OVHcloud has not published a power capacity, square footage, or formal certification for this building, so its scale relative to other US data center campuses cannot be determined from public information.

OVHcloud operates this site using a proprietary water cooling system designed to achieve low power usage effectiveness, and the company designs and manufactures its own servers with a focus on recycling and multiple operational lifecycles. Without published specifications, this facility cannot be ranked against other AI-scaled data centers on power delivery or compute density. Virginia has 330 mapped data center facilities overall, but only 23 publish power capacity figures totaling 1,375 MW, placing this campus outside the state's published capacity rankings.

For a reader assessing whether this campus matters to AI scaling, the absence of published technical specifications means it cannot be measured against the grid constraint thesis or compared to other facilities on power or compute grounds. The facility's age, European operator, and proprietary architecture suggest it serves cloud and hosting workloads, but whether those workloads include AI training and inference at scale remains undisclosed by OVHcloud.
